column1: # Tool options the live driver does not send, and why (docs/architecture.md
# §13). `gates live-cover` holds it against the surface and against
# testdata/live-cover-record.tsv, which scripts/livegitlab writes at the
# end of a run from what actually went out.
# Columns, tab-separated: tool.option (tool.* for the tool itself),
#   undrivable  something outside the driver's reach blocks it; say what
#   undriven    a step could send it and none does yet; say what closing
#               it takes. The count has a ceiling that only goes down.

column3: a second page needs two accounts that match one search, and the driver may find no account but the signed-in one (§9.1); gitlabtest pages it
the driver lists members by the signed-in username only, since everyone else a group gives access is another person (§9.1); a second page needs a second match, and gitlabtest pages it
